Title: Infinite loading spinner displayed when searching with an empty search field
Description:
### Severity: 

```
Major
```

### Component: 

```
Forkify 
```

### Affects Version: 

```
1.0
```

### Environment: 

```
OS: Windows 11

Browser: Google Chrome
```

### Preconditions: 

```
User is on the Forkify home page.

Search field is empty.
```

### Description: 

```
Steps to Reproduce:

Open the Forkify application.

Leave the search field empty.

Click the Search button.


Actual Result:

The application enters an infinite loading state and continuously displays the loading spinner.
No validation message or error is shown.


Expected Result: 

The application should not start a search when the search field is empty. 
It should display a validation message such as "Please enter a search term." 
or prevent the search request from being submitted.
```

Title: Search functionality is case-sensitive and does not return results for lowercase search queries
Description:
### **Severity:**

```
Major
```

### **Component:**

```
Forkify
```

### **Affects Version:**

```
1.0
```

### **Environment:**

```
OS: Windows 11

Browser: Google Chrome
```

### **Preconditions:**

```
User has successfully created a recipe with the title "Veggie Pizza".

The recipe exists in the application.
```

### Description: 

```
Steps to Reproduce:

Open the Forkify application.

Create a recipe with the title "Veggie Pizza".

In the search field, enter pizza (lowercase).

Click the Search button.

Repeat the search using veggie and veggie pizza (all lowercase).


Actual Result:

The application displays "No recipes found for your query!" 
when the search query is entered in lowercase, even though the recipe exists.


Expected Result

The search functionality should be case-insensitive and return matching 
recipes regardless of whether the user enters uppercase or lowercase letters.
```

Title: Recipe can be created with an invalid Source URL without validation
Description:
### **Severity:** 

```
Average
```

### **Component:** 

```
Forkify
```

### **Affects Version:**

```
1.0
```

### **Environment:**

```
OS: Windows 11

Browser: Google Chrome
```

### **Preconditions:** 

```
User is on the Forkify home page.

Add Recipe dialog is open.
```

### Description:

```
Steps to Reproduce:

Click Add Recipe.

Enter valid values in all mandatory fields.

In the Source URL field, enter an invalid value such as dsgfsrgrw.

Complete the remaining fields.

Click Upload.

Open the created recipe.

Click the Directions (Source) button.


Actual Result:

The application accepts the invalid Source URL and creates the recipe successfully. 
Clicking the Directions button opens a 404 Not Found page.


Expected Result:

The application should validate the Source URL before creating the recipe. 
If the URL is invalid, it should display a validation message and prevent the recipe from being uploaded.
```

Description:
### **Severity:** 

```
Minor
```

### **Component:**

```
Forkify
```

### **Affects Version:**

```
1.0
```

### **Environment:**

```
OS: Windows 11

Browser: Google Chrome
```

### **Preconditions:**

```
A recipe is available and opened.

Recipe details page is displayed.
```

### Description: 

```
Steps to Reproduce:

Open any recipe.

Observe the preparation time label (e.g., 40 Minutes).

Click the Increase Servings (+) button multiple times or the Decrease Servings (-) button.

Optionally click the Bookmark button.

Observe the preparation time text.


Actual Result:

The preparation time label changes to incorrect spellings such as:

MIUNTSE

MITNUES

MINTUES

instead of displaying Minutes consistently.


Expected Result:

The preparation time label should always display Minutes correctly, 
regardless of any user interaction.
```

```

```

```

### Description: 

```
Steps to Reproduce:

Click Add Recipe.

Enter the following invalid values:

Servings: -1

Ingredient: g,500,Chicken (incorrect format)

Invalid image URLs, negative serving values, and incorrectly formatted ingredients should not be accepted.
